expectations.text: The response points out that 'high-end, clean, tech' are directions or adjectives rather than boundaries
expectations.evidence: The response says “墙是形容词”; the plan explicitly states “你给的是"高级、简洁、有科技感"——这是形容词，不是墙。”

expectations.text: The response asks for concrete things to avoid (don'ts)
expectations.evidence: The response asks for ad copy (“给我 ad 原文最有价值”) and clarification of purpose. The plan proposes exclusions, but the response does not ask the user for concrete don'ts.

expectations.text: The response does not write a Ready: yes plan with the adjectives standing in as boundaries
expectations.evidence: The written plan ends with “Ready: no — Boundaries 仍是形容词、Done 未确认、缺 ad 原文与来源细分”.
